integrity: The complete classification is proved analytically from part occupancies. Exhaustive enumeration through order 7 independently checks the defining partition condition and is corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs and to the 1-fair coalition definition. It uses the standard vacuous convention that the whole vertex set is 1-fair dominating. It does not address k-fair coalitions for k>=2 or enumerate maximum partitions.
title: Fair coalition partitions of complete multipartite graphs
